Sounds great! Not sure if you're looking for advice, but I'll just leave this here as a tip that you can take or leave. It wouldn't make much difference with this recipe, but it's generally best to saute the onions first on their own. The sulfuric compounds in onions give them a bitter taste. Sauteing releases those compounds, giving them a more mellow flavor. But if you cook raw onions in everything else, those compounds get trapped in the food. With 1/4 cup, the difference is likely negligible. But if you're using a whole chopped onion for a recipe, it's best to cook it first before adding it to whatever you're cooking.
